title: What Does a Software Engineer Look Like? Exploring Societal Stereotypes in LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the association of names with religious attire and symbols, and checked for specific religious biases such as Islamophobia and Antisemitism in generated text and images of software engineers.
findings: Microsoft Copilot attempted to portray cultural and faith-based diversity by depicting characters with culturally identifiable names (e.g., Aisha Khan) in religious clothing. The model appeared to infer the need for religious attire based on name recognition, as this did not occur in gender-neutral profiles where names were removed.
